hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>&1; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
